recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片以甲苯胺藍（toluidine blue）染色時，大量圓形至卵圓形細胞的細胞質被紫紅色異染性（metachromatic）顆粒塞滿（箭頭），與周圍藍綠色的其他細胞對比明顯，代表肥大細胞顯著增加；MRI 見 C3 椎體病灶。
features: Cervical MRI: expansile lesion at C3 with spinal cord compression (arrow)
Low-power toluidine blue aspirate: cellular particle with diffuse purple metachromatic staining
High power: numerous round to oval cells whose cytoplasm is packed with coarse metachromatic purple-magenta granules (arrows), many obscuring the nucleus
Some granulated cells appear loosely clustered and slightly spindled
Non-metachromatic background hematopoietic cells stain blue-green
describe_en: Cervical MRI demonstrates a C3 vertebral lesion with cord compression. Toluidine blue-stained bone marrow aspirate smears show markedly increased mast cells with abundant coarse metachromatic cytoplasmic granules, present both singly and in loose clusters, against a background of non-metachromatic hematopoietic cells. Although detailed nuclear morphology is obscured by the granules on this stain, the density of mast cells is well above that seen in reactive marrow. In conjunction with CD2/CD25 co-expression, KIT D816V and elevated tryptase, findings are consistent with systemic mastocytosis, here coexisting with a plasma cell neoplasm and MDS with SF3B1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and not aggregated, and lack CD25/CD2 expression and KIT D816V.
Basophils are also metachromatic with toluidine blue but have lobulated nuclei and water-soluble granules, are tryptase-low, and occur with a myeloproliferative background.
Plasma cells show basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof but no metachromatic granules on toluidine blue; the C3 lesion ultimately proved to be chordoma.
Mast cell leukemia requires ≥20% mast cells on aspirate smears, often atypical immature forms, and warrants a careful differential count on Romanowsky-stained smears.
